title: Tenet
scope: The 2020 film · the two sides of the Oslo encounter
premise: At Oslo, the Protagonist fights a masked figure. Returning to that encounter reveals why both sides looked so strange.
ending: The Protagonist first fights a stranger, later returns as that masked fighter, then uses the turnstile to become the figure Neil chases. One person supplies all three appearances. The return explains the encounter he already experienced.

people.name: The Protagonist
people.introduction: The same person encountering an earlier stage of his own life.

events.title: He enters the Oslo freeport
events.text: The Protagonist and his colleague Neil enter a storage facility at Oslo airport, called the freeport. A staged plane crash provides cover. Inside, they find a machine with two revolving doors: a turnstile.

events.title: He fights someone moving strangely
events.text: Two masked figures appear on opposite sides of the turnstile. One fights the Protagonist, moving backwards relative to him. The other runs away, with Neil in pursuit.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · the forward side of the encounter

events.title: Later, he becomes inverted
events.text: Later, in Tallinn, the Protagonist passes through a turnstile. He is now inverted: while he experiences life normally, the world around him runs backwards. Travelling this way brings him back toward the day of the Oslo operation.
events.whenLabel: Tallinn · later by the ordinary calendar

events.title: He reaches Oslo from the other direction
events.text: The inverted Protagonist reaches the freeport around the plane crash. His route brings him into the same encounter that he previously experienced from the other side.

events.title: He is the masked opponent
events.text: He fights his earlier, uninverted self. The two appearances belong to one person at different points in his experienced life.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · the inverted side of the same encounter

events.title: The turnstile lets him move forward again
events.text: He passes through the Oslo turnstile and moves forward in time again. He is now the second masked figure, running from Neil. The fighter and the runner are the same traveller immediately before and after using the machine.
events.whenLabel: Oslo · after his passage through the turnstile

chapters.title: Return with a different direction
chapters.introduction: The next steps happen later in his life, even as the calendar takes him back to the earlier encounter.
